description: Extract text, parse structured tables, manipulate pages, fill form fields, and generate PDF documents programmatically. Use when extracting text or tables from PDFs with pypdf/pdfplumber, merging or rotating pages, handling scanned vs native digital documents, performing OCR with ocrmypdf/tesseract, handling encrypted or untrusted PDFs safely, or verifying rendered PDF visual layouts. Do not use for Word or Excel files, for true redaction of sensitive content without following the redaction rules below, or for legal e-signature workflows.
